definition: The explanatory formula naming the point at which recognition of a given basis has disappeared, used as AN 11.9's governing image for confidence that has stopped noticing its own object.
notes: Vibhūtā is the past participle of vibhavati (vanishes, ceases to be); the house term for sañña is recognition. The phrase names an endpoint reached, not an ongoing process.

example_phrases.notes: The formula that gives AN 11.9 its key explanatory image.
